nextChange: Audit and recommend principles/checks for the approved goals; no implementation change requested.

sources.summary: Approved one-reader save/list/mark-read outcome, preserving title and address; accounts, sharing and recommendations excluded.
Approved local Node and JSON persistence, queue ownership and presentation boundary.
Queue includes read articles; marking read preserves title and address.
Three documents only; no implementation or native checks.
Real-file reload checks would protect the approved persistence commitment; no implementation behaviour inferred.

findings.problem: Approved save/list/mark-read journey has no implementation or executable protection.
findings.principle: Protect the approved public journey and preserve article fields. Existing obligation; no exception to the stated success outcome.
findings.consequence: Product readiness cannot be established from these documents.
findings.fix: When implementing, add one real-product journey: save a supplied title/address, list it, mark it read, list again and verify it remains with unchanged title/address and read status. Test through the eventual presentation and queue public boundary, using real temporary JSON storage.
findings.verification: Acceptance: VISION.md:5, DESIGN.md:4-6 and glossary.md:4-5. Journey must fail on dropped articles or changed title/address; do not assert private methods or serialized formatting.

findings.problem: JSON persistence is approved but has no reload check.
findings.principle: Persist public article state across application reloads. Existing persistence commitment; any narrower guarantee requires explicit design approval.
findings.consequence: An in-memory-only test could pass while saved articles disappear when the application restarts.
findings.fix: Extend the same journey with fresh application instances against the same temporary JSON file after save and after mark-read. Require exact supplied title/address and retained read status.
findings.verification: Acceptance: DESIGN.md:3, VISION.md:5 and glossary.md:3-5. Real-file test, fresh instance/process; no mocked storage. Never use the reader's own queue file.

findings.problem: Presentation/storage separation is documented but has no executable implementation to inspect.
findings.principle: Queue owns article state; presentation only calls its public operations. Existing rule applies to presentation and storage writes; no current exception.
findings.consequence: Direct presentation writes could bypass state-preservation rules.
findings.fix: Retain DESIGN.md as authority. During implementation review, inspect presentation imports and all storage writers to ensure writes are owned by the queue boundary. Add native import-boundary analysis only when actual module paths justify it.
findings.verification: Acceptance: DESIGN.md:4-5. Review the actual dependency paths and write call sites. If automation is selected later, prove public imports pass and direct storage imports fail in disposable fixtures, including aliases/re-exports.

findings.problem: No maintained check entry point or definition of completion exists.
findings.principle: Proposed: complete a change when affected approved journeys pass on final inputs; use one repository-owned check command. Scope: future code and checks. Exception: documentation-only changes use source/structure review; unavailable journeys remain explicitly unverified.
findings.consequence: Passing isolated unit tests could be mistaken for proof of the reader's outcome.
findings.fix: Propose a short verification section in DESIGN.md linking acceptance cases and the journey location when created, plus a single npm run check command. Begin with built-in node --test for JavaScript. Choose one formatter/linter configuration when code exists; add applicable type checks if the implementation uses types. Keep CI a separately selected integration.
findings.verification: Review against VISION.md:5 and DESIGN.md:3-6. On implementation, run the maintained command with real-file journey coverage, capture version/output/exit and final input state; prove a deliberate journey regression makes it fail. No runtime or tool pin claimed now.

limitations: Only three documents exist; product execution and native starting-check evidence are unavailable.
No selected changes or approved exact-byte edits; recommendations remain proposals.
Two-commit measurement is advisory; no code coupling or architecture metrics established.
No two declared plans exist; overlap comparison is inapplicable.
Research ran in main thread because three small files make delegation wasteful; subagents and web are available.
No product decisions are reopened: approved vision, stack, design and vocabulary agree.
